# DELAX Field Archive

> Integrated pipeline that asset-izes street-walking and cycling footage from Málaga-based filmmaker DELAX (Hiroshi Kodera) and serializes it as Ambient Walk/Ride Tour episodes on the Tachi Radio YouTube channel. Pure environment audio, no narration.

## What this is

DELAX Field Archive is the metadata + automation backbone behind two YouTube series:

| Code | Series | Primary camera |
|---|---|---|
| **DWT** | DELAX Walking Tour | Insta360 X5 |
| **DBT** | DELAX Bike Tour | Sony ZV-E10 II |

Naming convention: `{SERIES}_EP{###}_{location-slug}_{YYYYMMDD}` (e.g. `DWT_EP001_Pedregalejo-Centro_20260428`).

The repo holds episode YAMLs, GPX tracks, thumbnail templates, and Python scripts that auto-fill metadata (ffprobe for capture meta, OSM Nominatim for location, Open-Meteo for weather). Video / audio source files are deliberately gitignored.

- Editorial style: no narration, location captions only (from GPS), ambient sound, BGM only when needed
- Privacy: GDPR-compliant face blur required for both cameras (Insta360 AI Face Blur / DaVinci Resolve Face Refinement)
- Quality bar: NHK-documentary craft × Vibe Coder velocity

## Output formats

- 9:16 short clips (1080×1920) — for YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels / TikTok with multi-platform safe-zones enforced
- 30–50min long-form HLG videos — "B-Music style" no-cut ambient tours with chapter markers + Lofi BGM mix

## What this is NOT

- Not a video host — raw footage stays on external SSD; YouTube is the publication surface
- Not a narration-driven travel vlog — strictly no-narration ambient walks/rides
- Not a transcription pipeline — see [csvtoxml](https://github.com/DELAxGithub/csvtoxml) and the Whisper-based Platto pipelines for that
- Not a video editor — editing is done in DaVinci Resolve / ffmpeg; this repo holds metadata and automation only
- Not a generic field-recording template — the directory layout, naming, and YAML schema are DELAX-specific
